Name: Anthro Grandpa
Author: Plebby999
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Re-adds The old Anthro grandpa that was removed from Anthro Characters Continued around the 7.# updates, but with some tweaks and compatibility with angry Grandpa. 
Don't ask me what species he is.
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#999999]Make sure to have Content Patcher installed then place this mod in the Mods folder.[/color]
